model_inference: none; actual Pi RPC model/session lifecycle operations; no prompt or provider inference

cases.name: extension_load

assertions.expected: The real Pi host loads the extension and its session_start hook restores model A and its thinking level after switching away.

cases.name: happy_path

assertions.expected: After selecting model A/high, creating a new session, selecting model B/low, and resuming A, actual Pi state is model A/high.
An unavailable model produces an explicit unsuccessful set_model RPC response while the actual Pi host remains free of unhandled and shutdown errors.

cases.name: reload_cleanup

assertions.expected: A second isolated actual Pi process loads the extension and observes its model-selection/session lifecycle.
The second Pi process resumes the selected session and observes the extension-restored model A/high response.
The second actual Pi process exits with status zero and no unhandled exception or shutdown error.
The native host shell launches the locally pinned Pi CLI and returns exactly its installed version.
